description: This Java source file defines security configuration for a Spring Boot application, including security filter chain, CORS policies, password encoding, and authentication manager setup.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up security-related beans and HTTP security rules in a Spring Boot application.

methods.name: securityFilterChain
methods.description: Configures HTTP security, including CORS, CSRF, authorization rules, session management, and JWT filter integration.

methods.name: passwordEncoder
methods.description: Provides a BCryptPasswordEncoder bean for password hashing.

methods.name: corsFilter
methods.description: Creates a CorsFilter bean that applies configured CORS policies.

methods.name: corsConfigurationSource
methods.description: Sets up the CORS configuration specifying allowed origins, methods, headers, and credentials.

methods.name: authenticationManager
methods.description: Creates an AuthenticationManager bean with a DAO authentication provider configured with user details service and password encoder.
